description: When Carlo Scarpa started at M.V.M. Cappellin and when he became its artistic director (1925–26 / 1926 / end 1926 / 1927–28).
Scarpa's collaboration with Venini starts 1932 (LSV, DBI); OS dates the title 'artistic director' from 1934.
Closure of M.V.M. Cappellin & C.: 1931 vs January 1932.
End of Martinuzzi's role at V.S.M. Venini & C.: 1931 vs 1932.
Martinuzzi's directorship of the Museo del Vetro: 1922–1931 (DBI) vs 1921–1931 (OS).
Which Zecchin left V.S.M. Venini & C. in 1932 – Francesco (partner) per DBI/OS Zecchin-Martinuzzi page; OS V.S.M. page is ambiguous and could be read as Vittorio.
Start of Bianconi at Venini: 1946 / 1947 / 1948.
Start of Tobia Scarpa at Venini: 1957 vs 1958.
Year the Barovier brothers took over Salviati's 1877 furnace: 1883 vs 1884 (OS inconsistent with itself).
Year the name 'Artisti Barovier' was adopted: 1890 (OS) vs 1896 (DBI).
Name of Salviati's 1877 Murano firm: 'Salviati dott. Antonio' vs 'Salviati & C.' (both on OS).
Nicolò Barovier: 1886–1953 (DBI) vs 1895–1947 (OS).
Founding year and founders of Barovier Seguso & Ferro: 1932 (DBI) vs 1933 (OS).
Year 'Seguso Vetri d'Arte' was adopted: 1937 (OS) vs 1933 (company timeline).
Flavio Poli's death: 1984 (OS) vs 1980 (Tier C).
End of Martens at Aureliano Toso: 1963 vs 1965 (both OS).
Founding of Aureliano Toso: 1938 (text) vs 1932 (header), both OS.
Alfredo Barbini's death: 2006 (OS) vs 2007 (Tier C).
Vetreria Alfredo Barbini: 1950 (text) vs 1932 (header), both OS.
Da Ros at Cenedese: 1958 vs 1959 (Tier C only).
Dealer claim that Walter Furlan worked at Cenedese 1940–45, before the firm existed (1946).
Fratelli Toso closed 1982 (OS) – current status of the name not established.
Ermanno Toso artistic director from 1936 (OS) vs from the late 1940s (Museo del Vetro).
Toso Vetri d'Arte: 1980 vs 1981 (OS).
Salviati & C.: London company 1866 (company history) vs Murano firm 1877 (OS) – probably two different entities with one name.
Pauly & C. founded 1902 (OS) vs 1903 (Tier C); Met object 'possibly Pauly' dated ca. 1860–70.
Historic Vetreria Vistosi closed early 1990s (OS) vs brand active today (company).
S.A.L.I.R. founded 1923 vs 1924.
Nason & Moretti founded 1923 vs 1925.
The Met uses anachronistic firm names for Venini objects (Venini S.p.a. for 1948; V.S.M. for 1949–56).
